round6_research.ai_marker: Commit message of introducer: '🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)' and 'Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>' — matches AI marker regex (claude); author/committer rUv.
round6_research.bug_semantics: OS command injection (CWE-78) in agentic-flow MCP server tools: attacker-influenceable tool parameters (agent, task, name, language, agentdb, key, namespace, etc.) interpolated into shell command strings passed to execSync(), e.g. `node "${cliPath}" --agent "${agent}" --task "${task}"` in agentic_flow_agent; a value like `x"; touch INJECTED; echo "` breaks out of the quoted arg and executes arbitrary OS commands. Reachable via stdio/HTTP/SSE MCP transports; fixed in 2.0.14.
round6_research.evidence: OSV GHSA-vcv2-r9jh-99m5 / CVE-2026-58195: prior to 2.0.14, MCP server tools in standalone-stdio.ts and fastmcp servers/tools interpolated params into execSync; OSV fixed ranges list 0c2ec967736a8b6b85832c6bae2a3e74989705ec and da901d06cc5661ebf3f66a962dc116464e7980b0 (the latter verified in ruvnet_ruflo clone: merge of PR #2415, 2026-06-18). Pickaxe `git log --all -S 'execSync(cmd' -- '*src/mcp*'`: earliest hit = 319c9861 (2025-10-04). `git show 8d643867:agentic-flow/src/mcp/fastmcp/servers/stdio-full.ts` shows the same interpolation pattern already present before standalone-stdio.ts existed. Fix PR #170 (head a0f9c2b, merged as 0c2ec967 by rUv, 2026-06-18) rewrote all sinks to execFileSync('npx', argv, {shell:false}) and added tests/security/cwe-78-mcp-execsync.test.ts. Advisory notes prior partial fix 6a06854 (#158) missed MCP files entirely.
round6_research.flaw_origin: MCP server tools with interpolated execSync sinks first appeared in commit 319c9861 (2025-10-04, rUv, 'feat: Restore all agentic-flow and agentic-llm updates') which created src/mcp/fastmcp/servers/stdio-full.ts and poc-stdio.ts already containing the pattern (e.g. memory_retrieve: `npx claude-flow@alpha memory retrieve "${key}" --namespace "${namespace}"` fed to execSync). Parent 08c4373f contains zero execSync usage anywhere (git grep empty), so the vulnerable behavior is absent in the parent. standalone-stdio.ts with agentic_flow_agent was added later the same day in b7855ba9 (same flaw pattern, not the minimum introducer).
round6_research.reasoning: Minimum atomic introducer is 319c98616bc968b6810c6c0b49e04806e7379530: the first commit writing the vulnerable execSync-interpolation pattern in MCP tools; its immediate parent 08c4373f has no execSync anywhere (parent_absent=true). The introducer commit message explicitly declares AI authorship ('Generated with Claude Code', 'Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>'), so the AI-written code created the vulnerability — closed causal chain on the introducer side. Fix-side commits (2026-06-18) are context only.
